headline: Bring AEP Texas energy usage into Home Assistant
intro: AEP Texas devices are supported through the Opower integration. The integration covers devices that are rebranded or share a common communication protocol; consult the Opower documentation for usage details.
highlights: Set up AEP Texas through its supporting Opower integration
Add it from Settings > Devices & services by selecting AEP Texas
Refer to the Opower integration documentation for usage information

flow.title: From AEP Texas selection to Opower usage
stages: Select AEP Texas and follow the on-screen instructions
Consult the Opower integration documentation for usage
